atoms.sound: Hi Fatima, I’m a little stuck on how to write my opinion piece. Can you help?
Sure! You mainly need to share your own views, but it’s also important to use facts to support your argument.
I’m a little unsure about the difference between an opinion and a fact.
There’s quite a big difference! A fact is something that is known to be true and can be proven, whereas an opinion is something you think or feel.
That makes sense! I think I can get started now.
